integrity.proof_basis: Exact cellular boundary matrices for the finite cubical model D(G,2), with rational Gaussian elimination.

scientific_limitations: The result is for one explicitly defined seven-vertex graph.
Only rational first-homology ranks are claimed; no integral torsion conclusion is asserted.
The result does not classify all double wedges or all two-vertex cuts.
title: A six-dimensional first-homology kernel at a two-vertex cut
